# CDM reference examples

Unmodified Rune JSON payload from FINOS CDM at the commit and path recorded in
[sources.json](sources.json). It is an upstream incomplete bullet-payments
translation: import/metadata preservation is supported, while CDM validation may
correctly report missing required product data. This fixture is not evidence of a
complete trade or successful payment-schedule execution.

The payload retains its upstream Apache-2.0 license and [notice](NOTICE.md).
Normal tests are offline and verify the pinned byte hashes. Update provenance,
hashes and license/notice together when refreshing the fixture.
